tei:div.tei:p: na mo badz+ra bhai ra wa ye/ 'dir chos skyong sna tshogs kyi gtor 'bul phyogs gcig tu brjod pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed nas/ yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ par bsams la nang mchod dang mchod gtor rnams bcu gsum ma ltar byin brlab bya ba'am/ bsdu na hūṃ/ rang nyid 'jigs mdzad zhal gcig phyag gnyis par/ / gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /mchod gtor kun gyi nyes skyon sbyangs shing spang*/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ bar bsam/ spyan 'dren ni rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung gi go rim ltar byas na/ hūṃ/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbyings su skad cig gis/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng*/ /yi dam kun 'dus 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /bstan srung rgya mtshos bskor nas bzhugs par gyur/ /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum mtshan hūm̐ yig las/ /'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas dus dgra'i dbang*/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas/ /spyan drangs dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur/ /shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gi dur khrod nas/ /myur mdzod ye shes mgon po phyag drug dang*/ /yid bzhin nor bu tshe bdag dbang gi rgyal/ /gnod sbyin dpal mgon tshogs bcas gnas 'dir byon/ /lho phyogs mi bzad lcags kyi grong khyer nas/ /las kyi gshin rje yum mchog tsa maṇ+ḍi/ /dreg pa pho mo'i dpung dang lhan cig tu/ /rnal 'byor 'phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ / byang shar mu le ding gi rgya mtsho nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung dmar zor rgyal mo ni/ /chu srin seng gdong dpal gyi lha mo dang*/ /tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma'i tshogs bcas gshegs/ /'og min rnam par snang mdzad thugs kha nas/ /gur mgon nag po mi'u thung gzugs can ni/ /lcam dral pu ṭa ming sring la sogs la/ /'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho dang bcas gshegs/

/mi g.yo 'og min chos kyi pho brang nas/ /rdo rje nag po bya rog mtshan can ni/ /legs ldan bya gdong gsum dang tsaṇ+ḍi ka/ /ma mo brgyad dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /po ta la dang ti se gangs sogs nas/ /nag po chen po zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa/ / yum bzhi zhing skyong sde brgyad tshogs dang bcas/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir da tshur gshegs/ /u rgyan yul gyi dur khrod chen po nas/ /he ru ka yi thugs sprul mthu rtsal can/ /dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po yab yum bcas/ / rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /'jigs rung ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas/ /dpal ldan mgon po bram ze dpa' bo'i gzugs/ /yum chen bzhi sogs 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas/ /rnal 'byor 'phrin las bsgrub phyir spyan 'dren no/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mthu stobs nus pa rnams/ /'jigs rung srin po khros pa'i skur bzhengs pa/ /bde chen lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /sna tshogs cho 'phrul dang bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /mthu stobs bdag po sprul pa'i gar mdzad pa/ /'dod rgu'i mchog ster rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin tshogs dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /byang shar ma ru rtsai yi dur khrod nas/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon lcam srid chen po ni/ /yum chen srid pa'i lha mo srog bdag dmar/ /gri thogs bshan pa'i tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang dang pad+ma thod 'phreng gi /spyan sngar bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /tha 'og chos rgyal la sogs srung ma'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs dgyes pa'i rten dang dbyer med gyur/ /mchod pa dang bskang rdzas sogs sngar byin gyis ma brlab na 'dir brlab pa'am/ mos pas kyang rung ste/ 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ/ yi dam bstan srung rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la/ /sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas gus phyag 'tshal/ /dam tshig nyams chags thams cad so sor bshags/

/ji snyed phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs dang*/ khrag dang bdud rtsi'i mchod yon mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /mdzes pa'i me tog sa dang bar snang gang*/ /sha chen gu gul spos kyi dud sprin 'khrigs/ /zhun chen mar me'i snang ba nyi ltar gsal/ /tsan dan ga bur dad ldang dri chab dang*/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas ri ltar spungs/ /snyan brjid rol mo'i sgra dbyangs sna tshogs kyis/ /yi dam bstan srung rgya mtsho 'khor bcas mchod/ / 'phrul ldan rta nag g.yag rog zhol chen dang*/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang ra skyes spyi dkar lug /mkha' lding bya dang dom 'dra'i khyi nag dang*/ /rin chen bdun dang 'dod yon rnam pa lnga/ /sra btsan go khrab rno ba'i mtshon cha'i tshogs/ khyad par zag med dam rdzas gtor ma ni/ /gling bzhi ri rab kun bzang mchod sprin bcas/ /yi dam bstan srung tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi/ /bzhes nas dam skong bar cad zhi ba dang*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /gtor ma sger du 'bul na/ yi dam bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags nas gsol bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba dharmā pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ sogs kyis lan gsum mam bdun gis 'bul zhing ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod dam min kyang rung la/ nang mchod yod na 'bul/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyag drug ye shes mgon/ /re ma ti dang gnod sbyin chen po bzhi/ /'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtshor bcas la bstod/ /gang zhig yin la dran pa tsam gyis kyang*/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /dpag bsam shing bzhin 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs pa/ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor la gus pas bstod/ / 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi bka' nyan mchog /dge sdig shan 'gyed chos kyi rgyal po zhes/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa kun srung ba/ /las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa bstod/

/rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /gcig bsdus 'jigs rung srin mo khros pa'i gzugs/ /dpal ldan dmag dang zor gyi rgyal mo la/ /rtse gcig gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung kun gyi gtso/ /gdug pa tshar gcod srin po khros pa'i sku/ /mi'u thung gur mgon lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyis bstod par bgyi/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin tshogs rnams rtag srung zhing*/ / 'jigs byed bzod par dka' ba'i shugs dang ldan/ /rngam pa'i stobs kyis bdud dpung tshar gcod pa'i/ /mgon po bya rog mtshan can khyod la bstod/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /mthing nag zhal bzhi 'jigs rung khros pa'i sku/ /yum chen bzhi sogs sprul pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo khyod la bstod/ /bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dngos/ /shin tu khros pa'i keng rus gzugs 'dzin pa/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs bskong ba'i/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum bcas la bstod/ /he ru ka ye sprul pa'i zlos gar nyid/ /sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rkang gling 'bud cing mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud/ /bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo khyod la bstod/ /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu kun/ /ma g.yel bu bzhin skyong ba zhal bzhes pa/ /bde chen lcam dral 'khor bcas bdag gis bstod/ /rab 'jigs gdong lnga'i dbang po 'gying pa'i steng*/ /rab mdzes gser gyi ri bo brtsegs pa bzhin/ /rab brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi ldan pa/ /drang srong rnam mang thos pa'i sras la bstod/ /gtum zhing drag la myur ba'i mthu rtsal gyis/ /drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub la thogs med pa/ /sgrol gyi drag po srog bdag dmar po la/ /sgo gsum mi phyed dad pa'i yid kyis bstod/

/bshad sgrub bstan pa srung ba'i mthu rtsal can/ /gnod sbyin chen po tha 'og chos rgyal sogs/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /mchod cing gus pa chen pos rtag tu bstod/ /mthu ldan chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas la/ /mchod bstod gsol bas rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /'gal rkyen bar chad nye 'tshe zhi ba dang*/ /'dod don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /rten yod na bdag dang 'gro la sogs kyi brtan bzhugs dang*/ /med na/ nyes byas bzod bzhes rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ slar yang byon nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*/ /dus rnams kun du dge legs 'phel bar mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang*/ paṇa chen gong ma gnyis kyi man ngag la brten nas gzhan phan gyi bsam pas sbyor ba ste/ rnam pa gnyis ka ltar na'ang 'di ltar byed par byung na gtor 'bul tsam du ma zad/ bskang gso bsdus pa byas par 'gyur ba yin no/ /bkra shis/ shubaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/chos skyong rnams kyi gtor 'bul bzhugs/ -PAGE 294--PAGE 295--PAGE 290-
